_comment: Locked by initech-kzfs under ADR-0003 DEC-07a; explicit lane ruling selects content sniffing so shipped ATA superfloppies remain valid. Not an INT21h AH register. IBM DOS 3.30 TR pp2-31,9-3..9; mtools mpartition type policy for type 06.
raw_detection: E9 or EB xx 90; media F0 or F8..FF; validated BPB
hidden_sectors: equal base_lba; mismatch fails loud (provisional DEC-07a)
offset_layer: volume mount; raw blockdev stays device-relative
absolute_sector: device LBA = volume base_lba + logical sector
error_note: DEC-07a proposed -16 before later features allocated -16..-19; -20 preserves uniqueness.
